config.label: A three
config.description: A three.ws API key (sk_live_… / sk_test_…) or OAuth access token for the account whose notifications you want to read and manage, carried as Authorization: Bearer. Required — every endpoint is account-scoped. Aliases: THREE_WS_TOKEN, THREE_WS_BEARER. Treat like a password.

config.label: Base URL of the three
config.description: Base URL of the three.ws API. Override only when self-hosting or targeting a preview deployment.
